name: VBrato
tagline: Collaboration and monetization marketplace for musicians
role: Mobile development for a US music-tech startup

scenes.title: Artists meet creatives
scenes.body: Releasing artists team up with songwriters, producers and engineers to post, pitch and get paid for work.

scenes.title: Profiles backed by streaming stats
scenes.body: Search the catalog, claim your artist page and see Spotify, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube numbers together.

scenes.title: Paid briefs with audio submissions
scenes.body: Post a project, collect demos from collaborators and stream each one in-app before choosing.

scenes.title: Offers checked against the wallet
scenes.body: Fee, deadline and requirements in one form; offers arrive as chat messages over GraphQL subscriptions.

scenes.title: Collaborators by audience
scenes.body: Filter by listeners, followers and playlist reach; audiences split by age, gender, language and location.

scenes.title: A wallet for music deals
scenes.body: Top up by card or bank through Stripe, track earnings and cash out; Pro plans bill through the stores.
